mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_order WHERE kind = 'PURCHASE' AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL') AND delivery_date < #{today}) AS "purchaseOverdue", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_order WHERE kind = 'SALES' AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL') AND delivery_date < #{today}) AS "salesOverdue", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_shipment WHERE status = 'EXCEPTION') AS "shipmentException", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_trade_draft WHERE kind = 'PURCHASE_IN') AS "purchaseInDraft", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_trade_draft WHERE kind = 'PURCHASE_RETURN') AS "purchaseReturnDraft", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_trade_draft WHERE kind = 'SALES_OUT') AS "salesOutDraft", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_trade_draft WHERE kind = 'SALES_RETURN') AS "salesReturnDraft"
